title: Mission: Button Golfer
subtitle: Build the golfer and learn how it swings.
summary: Meet the button golfer, learn its parts, and press the button to swing the club.
activityInstruction: Press the button to make the golfer swing the club and hit the ball.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does the golfer use to hit the ball?

storyQuestions.success: Pressing the button makes it swing.

storyQuestions.prompt: Where does the golfer try to send the ball?
What moves when the golfer swings?
storyQuestions.success: The arms and club move together.

quiz.prompt: Where does the ball need to go?
quiz.success: The ball goes toward the hole.

parts.label: Hat
parts.fact: The golfer wears a cap to block the sun.

parts.label: Head
parts.fact: The head holds the eyes that watch the ball.

parts.label: Body
parts.fact: The body holds the golfer together.

parts.label: Arms
parts.fact: The arms hold the club and swing it.
parts.help: The parts that hold the club.

parts.label: Club
parts.fact: The club hits the ball toward the hole.
parts.help: The stick in the golfer's hands.
